services.name: Parasailing: Duck
services.desc: There's nothing quite like floating along hundreds of feet above the water taking in a beautiful view of the Duck boardwalk and northern Outer Banks! Our parasail boat leaves straight from the dock-no tendering taking up your adventure time. We'll make sure you're strapped in safely then send you up for a 10-12 minute flight before reeling you back down. Back on the boat, keep an eye out for local wildlife like turtles and osprey!
